newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian leading indicator up sharply in September.
newsitem.headline: Belgian leading indicator up sharply in September.

text.p: The Belgian central bank released the following indices based on its monthly survey of three key economic sectors -

NOTE - The leading index is based on central bank surveys of manufacturing, construction and retailing and calculated on the basis of the difference between positive and negative answers to the bank's questions. It is slightly positive at the top of an economic cycle, while it is strongly negative at the depth of a recession.

In a statement, the central bank attributed September's rise to better sentiment in manufacturing industry, where capacity utilisation rates averaged 80.1 percent in the third quarter, up from 79.3 percent in the previous three months.
